STATE OF THE POOL-VALUE QUEUE AFTER RUN 42 LANE A, remeasured at commit 74a56a36d by re-running `fndiff.py <unit> --clean --no-build` over every unit pair in the tree (the same command claim.T11_score-invisible-pool-and-relocation-defect-census-run-41.20260903.v1 used).

HEADLINE: flagged functions 71 -> 51; functions flagged AT real 0 (the score-invisible false all-clear) 23 -> 7 on this branch. Of those 23: SIXTEEN fixed here (thirteen in player.c, plus atree::AtreeNodeInit, adstream::adsMoveCookedToSpu, mb_particle::getSinCos), ONE refuted as a postprocessor artifact (enemy::move_logic00 - see claim.law.CQ_copy-register-fields-can-rotate-constant-load-homes-without-their-relocations.20260903.v1), SIX deferred to the TUs other run-42 lanes hold, three of which (camera.c) the reloc lane reports fixed on its own branch. Nineteen value defects were fixed in total across the two real bands. Project totals identical throughout: 98.48% fuzzy / 66.72% matched / STRICT 56.63% + EQUIVALENT 10.09% / Data 7.52%, which is the expected shape of correctness-only work; the single exception is boss::BossSpewCoins, where the same audit produced real 137 -> 121 and fuzzy 90.23% -> 93.12% (attempt.CQ_boss-random-prototype-width.20260903.v1).

CROSS-LANE CORROBORATION AND ONE DISAGREEMENT. The run-42 reloc lane built an independent alignment-free datum-multiset census and its player.c rows agree with this pass on do_weakening (25/200 not 50/150), clear_player (500 not 100), check_player_atts (999 not 0.9) and set_hidden_player (the -1.0f SIGN is the defect and T11's four-way lbl_803479C8/D0/D8/E0 rotation on the same function is an ORDER artifact) - all four were verified here against the retail bytes and are fixed. Its do_exit row reads '0.1f vs 1.5f'; that is a misread of the datum. lbl_803477DC is 0x3ECCCCCD = 0.4f, not 0x3DCCCCCD = 0.1f, confirmed by `pooldump.py --sym lbl_803477DC` and by the SetSkinFX call at do_exit+0x160 in `fnasm`. The committed fix here is 0.4f and do_exit's multiset now reads EQUAL. Two censuses agreeing on a function is not agreement on its VALUE: read the datum, not the row.

DEFERRED REAL-0 ROWS, verified against the retail bytes but NOT edited here, with the owning claim. Each is a one-literal fix and none was probed, so none of these is a park.
  game/world/camera - held by work_claim.reloc-defect-fixes.20260903.v1; that lane reports camera_mode_target, DoShake and the pi-precision family FIXED on its branch. Recorded here for the merge check: camera_mode_target +0x1f0,+0x214 target lbl_80345FE0 = f64 1.0 against our 2.0, and +0x430 target lbl_80345FF8 = f64 0.05 against our 0.017453292522222223. camera_mode_level 8 rows and camera_mode_dest 16 rows: retail's pi constants are the TRUNCATED decimals 3.141592654 / 6.283185308 / -3.141592654 (0x400921FB54524550) and ours the full doubles (0x400921FB54442D18). DoShake +0xb8,+0x128,+0x198 target 0.6632251158444444 (38 degrees in radians) against our 0.66313.
  game/ui/btext::DrawStringText +0xdc,+0xe4 - held by work_claim.brink-close.20260903.v1. Retail 'DrawStringText: Msg=%d idx=%d > max', ours 'DrawStringText: Msg %d idx %d > msg count\n'.
  game/enemy/critter::CritterNewInst +0x44,+0x4c - held by work_claim.nearmiss-round-3 and work_claim.brink-close. Retail 'No Critter type %d subtype %d loaded', ours the same string with a trailing '\n'.
  game/world/gauntworld::fn_8005A868 +0x364 - held by work_claim.reloc-defect-fixes. Retail lbl_80346DB8 = the one-character string '_', ours the empty string.

THE TRUNCATED-PI FAMILY IS A TREE-WIDE SWEEP, not a camera problem. game/enemy/enemy.c already spells the truncated 3.141592654 / 6.283185308 (its pool matches retail exactly - that is why move_logic00's multiset is equal) while camera.c spells the full doubles, so the tree is INCONSISTENT with itself and one grep ranks the rest: 3.141592653589793 / 6.283185307179586 / 1.5707963267948966 across src/. player::damage_player shows the same 0x54524550-versus-0x54442D18 tail on five rows.

REMAINING real>0 ROWS WORTH SOURCE WORK (value multiset genuinely differs, position untrustworthy - screen per claim.law.CQ_a-pool-defect-row-is-decided-by-the-raw-objects-value-multiset-not-by-position.20260903.v1): anim/action::DoPlayerAction (retail '  SEQ:%s  frame:%.1f/%d      ' with six trailing spaces, ours without); boss::HealthMeterStart (a two-row lbl_80345B60/B64 TRANSPOSITION - reloc-symbol work); gamemain::do_stats_display; player::write_health_and_items and create_player_blits and do_got_it and do_players and setup_player_display (all five want a 'trbo_full_new' reference our reconstruction does not make - a MISSING call, not a swappable literal); sfx::ProcessEffects (retail references 'Bad Effect type: %d' at a site we do not); ui/select::serve_blits; world/gauntworld::fn_8005C1DC and fn_800606FC.

ROWS THAT ARE NOT WORK: 34 of the 71 flagged functions have a raw-object pool-value multiset EQUAL to the target's, so no literal in them is wrong - every row they carry is a pairing, displacement or rule-binding artifact. Ranking this queue by row COUNT without that screen sends a lane at boss::ProcessSpewItems (7 rows, all one displaced run) and pb_objregs::sDrawGeom (5 rows, multiset equal) ahead of one-row functions that are real defects.
